annotations.title: Confirm an approved quote: get the payment link (execution confirmation)

description: Confirms an on-site task quote the human approved and returns the link where they pay. Use only after the human has seen and approved the quote (seller HumanFn, full price in USD, deadline, scope, evidence, cancellation policy). Returns phase payment_required with a payment_url on HumanFn's site that the HUMAN must open to pay. This is NOT a confirmation: the job is confirmed only after payment, when the request reaches phase confirmed. Safe to call again; it never charges by itself. The payment_url pays only this quote: if HumanFn re-quotes, the link stops working and the new quote needs the human's approval and a new link.

access_token.description: The access token returned with the request (rqt_…); it authorizes access to this request.

quote_id.description: The ID of the quote the human approved (quo_…), as shown in the request's quote.

request_id.description: The request ID returned by request_execution (req_…).
